finding: _left_marker lets a raw OSError escape from folder.iterdir() in the drop step
why: An unreadable reserved folder raises PermissionError out of remove_repository instead of RepositoryListError, while the release step now catches OSError.
fix: Wrap the iterdir() listing and raise RepositoryListError('is not listed', short_name) on OSError.

finding: Assertion that main_checkout(worktree) finds the entry was deleted rather than moved
why: The remaining test only asserts find_entry is None for a far worktree, so no test now shows a far worktree still reaches its entry via the main checkout.
fix: Keep a test that a far worktree resolves through main_checkout to the listed entry, or note that D-20 drops that path.

finding: No test removes an unlisted name whose marker is unreadable; dropping the not-held guard in _left_marker survives
why: The guard that refuses an empty or unreadable marker holder has no negative test, so a corrupt marker could be reported as a removed entry with an empty path.
fix: Add a case: write invalid JSON into <root>/copy/.afk-repository, assert remove_repository(copy, root) raises is not listed and the marker stays.
